Hey everyone! 

So yes, the day has finally arrived: Life Forge Steam Release! For this little update I wanna go over some things that may need addressing.

~Lag/Connectivity Issues
As some of you are noticing, there are a few lag spikes going around. Rest assured we are working hard to smooth everything over and to ensure a quality, stable connection at all times!

~Server Downtime
Some of you have also noticed some crashes. Given a little time these will go from few to none. 100+ people find bugs much quicker than 50+. Thanks again for your patience in the matter!

~My game won't run!
Feel free to contact a staff member on our Discord, our Website (www.lifeforgerpg.com), or even on Steam. We'll try to get you all sorted out!

~The server is full! What do I do?
Currently, while our team is working hard to work in some new Server Channels, the only thing you can do is wait, we're afraid. We'll be trying to increase server limits as we progress!

Lastly, we please ask you to refrain from posting a terrible review unless you actually had a terrible experience. If this isn't your type of game, that's fine! If you have a genuine issue with the game, our Staff will attempt to rectify it for you. We simply ask this as to not scare away any potential player that may really enjoy the game.

Thank you all for your patience and dedication to Life Forge! As we roll out patches and whatnot, we'll be sure to post the changelogs here!

-Life Forge Team

Some of you have also noticed some crashes. Given a little time these will go from few to none. 100+ people find bugs much quicker than 50+. Thanks again for your patience in the matter!

~My game won't run!
Feel free to contact a staff member on our Discord, our Website (www.lifeforgerpg.com), or even on Steam. We'll try to get you all sorted out!

~The server is full! What do I do?
Currently, while our team is working hard to work in some new Server Channels, the only thing you can do is wait, we're afraid. We'll be trying to increase server limits as we progress!

Lastly, we please ask you to refrain from posting a terrible review unless you actually had a terrible experience. If this isn't your type of game, that's fine! If you have a genuine issue with the game, our Staff will attempt to rectify it for you. We simply ask this as to not scare away any potential player that may really enjoy the game.

Thank you all for your patience and dedication to Life Forge! As we roll out patches and whatnot, we'll be sure to post the changelogs here!

-Life Forge Team
